1969.name: 440 Six Barrel (A12)

sources.name: Conceptcarz (Dan Vaughan): Plymouth GTX history
sources.says: claims the 1969 GTX 440 got three 2-bbl carbs for 390 hp

1969.note: Not a 1969 GTX engine. The mid-1969 A12 440 Six Barrel package was a Road Runner (and Dodge Super Bee) option only. NHRA lists no 440/390 under 1969 GTX; Wikipedia and MuscleCarClub give the 440-6 to the GTX in 1970 only; the 1969 GTX brochure lists only the 440 4-bbl and Hemi. Conceptcarz alone claims it and is wrong. The 1969 A12 belongs on the Road Runner page.
